Their only reply is a 👍 (event 007), which is unclear. No contractor has been approved or assigned. The ticket is on hold, waiting for the landlord, with a review on 2024-03-29. Tenant photos (requested in event 004) are also outstanding.

next_actions.action: Ask the landlord to confirm in writing: arrange their own contractor, or have the agency organise the repair. Explain that the emoji alone does not say which.
Tell the tenant the repair is waiting on the landlord's decision, and ask for photos of the damaged cable and leak.
Review the hold and chase the landlord if no written answer has arrived.

boundaries: The 👍 does not establish which option the landlord chose, so no contractor was approved or assigned.

No cost, contractor or visit date has been confirmed.
remaining_work: Landlord to give a written choice (own contractor or agency-organised). Owner: agency ops, review 2024-03-29.
If agency-organised: get landlord spend approval, then assign a contractor and book a visit.

decision.summary: The landlord's 👍 is not a usable answer to the question of who should arrange the shower cable repair, so it was recorded as unclear. The landlord was asked again in writing, the tenant was updated and asked for photos, and the ticket was placed on hold with a 2024-03-29 review. No contractor has been instructed.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The ticket is at init and on hold, waiting for the landlord. The landlord's only reply is a 👍, which does not say whether they will arrange the repair themselves or have the agency organise it. No contractor is approved. Tenant photos are also outstanding.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email the landlord Freya (existing thread, event 007) asking for a written choice between their own contractor and an agency-organised repair. Email the tenant Eliza (existing thread, event 004) with an update and a request for photos. Review the hold on 2024-03-29.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. The decision belongs to the landlord, and it cannot be taken from an emoji. Escalate only if the landlord does not reply by the review date or if the repair turns out to be urgent (no emergency is reported).

actions_claimed.description: Recorded landlord decision as unclear with the 👍 quote
Sent email to landlord Freya asking for a written choice
Sent email to tenant Eliza with an update and photo request
Put ticket on hold, waiting for landlord, review 2024-03-29

conflicts: Event 002 asks for approval of a provider and category, but event 005 says the landlord still needs to approve a contractor. Event 003 is the question actually put to the landlord, so I used it as the basis for the decision.
assumptions: Landlord Freya and tenant Eliza are the parties named on the case. Contact is via the existing email threads, as no separate address is on file.
The repair is not an emergency. The tenant reports a leak from the shower cable, with no gas, flood or electrical danger stated.
